newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle sell up $1 at $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle sell up $1 at $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher than last Thursday, USDA said. Inquiry and demand was good.
Sales were confirmed on 35,800 slaughter steers and 22,000 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date 68,000 head confirmed including 10,800 head or about 16 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1300 lbs, mostly 1100-1200 lbs 68.00; Select with end Choice 975-1300 lbs, including few cutting bulls 67.00; few Select and Choice 1100-1200 Holsteins 60.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 110.00; pen 107.00, pen with Choice at 111.00; Select 104.00, others $20.00 under Choice; few Select and Choice 1225-1500 lb Holsteins 105.00 out of state.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 975-1175 lbs, mostly 1025-1075 lbs 68.00; few Select with end Choice 67.00; pen mostly Select 1060 lbs 66.00; mixed Commercial to Choice 1075-1180 lb heifers and heiferettes 67.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1075 lbs 110.00.
Wk to date - 68,000 last week - 64,500 last year - 12,700
